# ARCOA

> ARCOA is a leader in secure IT asset remarketing, recovery, and recycling with 30+ years of expertise in compliant data destruction and sustainable electronics processing.

ARCOA provides comprehensive IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) solutions combining secure data erasure, certified e-waste recycling, specialized logistics, and value recovery for enterprises across multiple industries. The company holds certifications including e-Stewards, NAID AAA, RIOS, and ISO 14001, operating facilities in key locations like Waukegan and serving clients nationwide.

## Core Services

- [IT Asset Disposition](https://www.thinkarcoa.com/services/it-asset-disposition): ARCOA's IT Asset Disposition service maximizing ROI with secure data destruction
- [Electronics Recycling](https://www.thinkarcoa.com/services/electronics-recycling): Certified e-scrap recycling and processing with data destruction and value recovery
- [Cybersecurity & Data Destruction](https://www.thinkarcoa.com/services/cybersecurity): Data erasure and destruction expertise for secure IT asset decommissioning
- [IT Asset Logistics](https://www.thinkarcoa.com/services/specialized-logistics): Secure IT asset transportation with specialty loading and nationwide shipping
